subject: ist-f
title: IST.F.------JR.DYN.
description: Chart 1 of 3 on book p. 300 (PR.S(RD)II-54). IST-F (isolated focus) is the subject; JR-DYM (journalism dynamics) is the partner (the title writes JR.DYN.). From the subject: INFO-COMP (information compression), VT-DY (vibrational dynamics), SOC-RT-DT (social reality dictates) and TRS (transition). From INFO-COMP: CN-INFO (controlled information). From VT-DY: SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics). From SPT-DY: V-SY (value system). From SOC-RT-DT: PART (participation). From TRS: DE-SPTL (despiritualization). From DE-SPTL: DIS-C-CT (disintegration of a culture’s center).
